hooks.command: claude --print "Automatic study-notes update. Steps: 1) Read the first 60 lines of C:\\Arcane-Index\\wiki\\log.md to find today's ingest entries. 2) Read C:\\Arcane-Index\\study notes\\index.md and locate the 'Create Study Notes For' table. 3) For each row where Auto-Update is 'yes', check if today's log has an ingest entry whose source path contains that row's Source Pattern. 4) For each module that had a new ingest today: read the new wiki source page from wiki/sources/, identify any content (sections, formulas, examples) not yet present in the study notes file, and append new sections following the existing file's format and style. Update the formula sheet if new formulas were introduced. Append new topic keywords to that module's Coverage Summary cell in study notes/index.md. 5) If no tracked modules had new ingests today, exit silently with no output. Use British English. Only add delta content — never rewrite existing correct content."
